events.text:
I couldn't make the post. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits left. I tried twice, at 640px square on free-plan models: first with qwen-image-2.1, which is good at clear text (about 10 credits), then with z-image-turbo, one of the cheapest (about 5 credits). Both were refused, so nothing was made.

**To get it made:**
- **Add credits:** buy a credit pack, or wait for your free credits to refill, then tell me and I'll run it again. A single image takes about 5–10 credits.
- **Use another image tool:** here's the prompt I wrote, so you can paste it in:

> Instagram feed post for a small houseplant shop. Lush arrangement of many healthy potted houseplants (monstera, pothos, fiddle leaf fig, snake plant, ferns, trailing ivy) in simple terracotta and matte white ceramic pots, grouped along the bottom and sides. Clean, plain warm cream background with soft natural daylight and gentle shadows, minimal and airy. At the top center, an elegant headline in deep forest green serif lettering that reads exactly: "Bring home some green". The headline is the only text in the image: no other words, letters, logos, labels or watermarks. Fresh, inviting, high-quality product photography style.

When it runs on your free plan, it will be a 640×640 square, which works for an Instagram feed post. AI image tools sometimes get the lettering wrong, so check the headline once it's made.
